incidents.name: STRAC token business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: STRAC's transfer accounting lets a caller inflate the liquidity pair's implied balance without a sync(), so the attacker swapped the resulting imbalance out for the pair's ETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: STRAC 0x1f90bdeb5674833868ee9b36707b929024e7a513 created 2022-07-28T09:04:57Z by 0xd1feb6b0c23f36798d9c6c6a88ec7a7a309d59ef, unrelated to attack sender 0xc7823188d459e1744c0e5fd58a0e074e92982ea3; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 12.1629 BSC-pegged ETH left 0x2976bd3774622367ce7a575d28201480e640966f to the attacker; 12.1629 ETH x $1,900.04 at incidentTimestamp 1687890170 (DefiLlama coingecko:ethereum) = $23,110.
